protocol.label: Astex — multi-seed Vina ensemble sampling diagnostic (run 6, diagnostic)
protocol.status: PREREGISTERED BEFORE ANY RESULT WAS COMPUTED — frozen protocol, amendments only by append
protocol.purpose: measure whether pooling poses from a fixed set of independent Vina seeds raises the native-like pose availability ceiling above run 4's 68/85, and quantify the stochastic error bar on the single-seed result
protocol.notAHeadline: DIAGNOSTIC. This run does NOT produce a new headline. The preregistered headline stays run 3's 46/85 top-1 until a separately frozen full run replaces it. No ranking change is made here.

preparation.base: the preregistered run-3 preparation, imported unchanged
preparation.phase2Rule1: covalently linked multi-residue ligands are absorbed into the ligand using element covalent radii plus 0.40 A, excluding water, single-atom metal ions, the additive list and residues the cofactor rule already keeps; over the 85 this changes 1GKC only (10 -> 22 heavy atoms)
preparation.phase2Rule2: chemically modified amino-acid residues that are peptide-bonded into the chain are typed from the wwPDB CCD with polymer leaving atoms removed and kept as part of the rigid receptor; over the 85 this changes 1HVY, 1JLA, 1MEH, 1XM6
preparation.phase2Rule3: none — the protonation and histidine audit found no defect and nothing was implemented

seeds.rule: seed_i = 42 + 1000*i for i in 0..4; 42 is the preregistered run-3 seed. Fixed before the run, identical for all 85 cases.
seeds.forbidden: no per-PDB seed choice, no searching seeds until a case succeeds, no adding or dropping a seed after seeing any result

pooling.method: pool all poses from all 5 seeds per case, then deduplicate deterministically
pooling.dedup: two poses are the same if their symmetry-aware heavy-atom RMSD to each other is below 1.0 A, matching Vina's own min_rmsd; the survivor is the one with the better Vina score, ties broken by (seed index, rank) ascending
pooling.ordering: the pooled pose list is ordered by Vina score ascending, ties broken by (seed index, rank) ascending
pooling.retained: the top 20 pooled poses define the top-K windows, so the ceiling is comparable to run 4's top-20; the full deduplicated pool is also reported separately as bestAvailable

metrics: top-1 / 3 / 5 / 10 / 20 coverage over the pooled poses, denominator 85
sampling ceiling: cases with any pose under 2.0 A anywhere in the deduplicated pool, denominator 85
comparison against run 4: ceiling 68/85, top-1 46, top-3 59, top-5 63, top-10 66, top-20 68
per-seed single-seed top-1, to quantify the stochastic error bar on the 46/85 result
cases newly reaching a native-like pose, and cases that lose one
the list of cases still with no pose under 2.0 A
protocol.successCriterion: RMSD < 2.0 A, symmetry-aware heavy-atom RDKit CalcRMS, no superposition
protocol.denominator: all 85 cases, always; no case excluded, no threshold change, no per-target tuning
protocol.immutability: runs 1-5, their evidence and both earlier preregistrations are untouched
